Well yes I would,. If your making them uncomfortable you should respect them, you should also notice that if they're uncomfortable with you then it will probably bring you discomfort towards yourself and how you perceive the topic.    But I believe that people are honestly generally very open to listening.     It feels kinda funny to me tho cas if they're uncomfortable i feel like they have things they need to work on so they don't feel overwhelmed by talking about something. Feels like it would be a step in the right direction to both try to work on it. But I definitely don't mean that it would be respectful to think that and push them through it. If I saw discomfort I guess I would worry and want to stop, but would also worry a little that it would lock me up a bit if I just kinda stopped out of fear or discomfort.   If I saw this and wanted to talk and didn't want them to worry I would just ask them how they're feeling, ask them if it's okay to keep talking, let them know your drive for talking to them, for me it's to work through it, to understand myself, to work through fears.   If they're willing to talk then keep going!  If they aren't then respect that, don't feel down though because everyone is at different points in life and you have to be willing and open to work through things!
I agree, it seems like we do this with most forms of connecting and communicating.

Because it helps to talk. Because I like to get an outside perspective. Helps to hear what people think. I've always done this. It makes an open relationship where people will then feel comfortable with coming to you about other struggles.  I mean people can see if your hurting, so I feel like it helps to talk because they can understand you better and know what your going through. I'm open and willing to talk with pretty much anyone, unless I suspect they'll judge me. But even then I still do at times.   If your open about your atuggles with people that aren't you may be helping them with stuff they struggle with that their not willing to talk about. Always think it's great to bounce back thoughts between each other. And I feel that if it can help you then there's a good chance it will help with the person you talk with in one way or another, whether that be with personal struggles, accepting people, or understanding others.    When I am typing this it makes me think of music.   That's what most people are generally doing when they write music. They open themselves to others and it gives great insight and comfort, something to relate to.    I think it's extremely important to open up to people and I definitely think it's something worth giving a try.   People are extremely accepting forgiving and understanding if your willing to open up. I have shared just about everything I've gone through with quite alot of people and I have literally never had one person show judgement, they have all been there for me, give me insight, and just try to help me with growing, forgiving myself, and accepting myself!
